metadata.description: Open-source mods for Claude Code: panes, bands, status lines, toasts and hooks, written as plugins of function hooks.

plugins.name: agent-flow
plugins.description: Animated timeline pane of the orchestrator and its subagents: who is thinking, acting or waiting, and the messages between them

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: Band above the prompt showing context %, tools, skills and MCP share of context, and session and weekly limits, with yellow and red usage indicators
